title: Lane run stops a worker whose edits and test results stop changing
body:
Why: operator-shared AI LABS videos 3DklR44DHnM and S49gppZl8H0 (descriptions only, .krn/sources/videos/): a worker looping on the same failing fix burns its turn ceiling; KRN has turn ceilings and timeouts but no progress detector in src/cli/lane-run.
Outcome: krn lane run tracks the diff hash and failing-test set per Stop attempt; after 3 attempts with no change it ends the lane with a no-progress verdict naming the repeated failure, instead of running out the ceiling.
Files: src/cli/lane-run/session.ts, src/cli/lane-run/verdict.ts, src/cli/lane-run/result.ts, tests.
Proof: a lane-run test on a verbatim capture of three identical Stop refusals prints the no-progress verdict and exits with its code.
